title: 第25章 苦战强敌第26章 苏念卿的泪
content_zh:
、顾渊走回医疗棚的时候，腿在发抖。
不是害怕的颤抖，是身体到了极限之后的本能反应。
左肩的绷带已经被血浸透了一大片，暗红色的血渍在白色的布料上蔓延，像是一幅泼墨画。
大腿上的伤口重新裂开，每走一步都有温热的液体顺着裤管往下淌，在青石板上留下一串暗红色的脚印。
朱八斗扶着他，庞大的身躯弯成了一个奇怪的角度，尽量让顾渊的手臂搭在自己的肩膀上。
“慢点，慢点。“
朱八斗的声音很低，带着一种平日里很少见的紧张：“台阶，注意台阶。“
医疗棚里，陈牧已经醒了。
他躺在稻草床上，脸色还是苍白得像纸，但眼睛睁着，目光随着顾渊的移动而移动。
他的肋部缠着厚厚的绷带，白色的布料下隐约透出一点淡红色的痕迹。
“赢了吗？“陈牧问。
声音很轻，像是从很远的地方飘来。
“赢了。“
朱八斗把顾渊扶到另一张稻草床上：“一剑。金色的。十丈长的光剑，把赵玄龙那小子的青锋劈成两截。“
陈牧“嗯“了一声，眼皮慢慢合拢，又睡了过去。
顾渊坐在床上，背脊挺得笔直，像是一柄插在地上的剑。
医师走过来，解开他左肩的绷带，伤口在空气中暴露——一道从左肩延伸到锁骨的切口，深可见骨，边缘被金色剑气灼烧过，呈现出一种诡异的焦黑色。
医师皱了皱眉：“这伤口里有剑气残留，我得先把残气逼出来，才能上药。会很疼。“
顾渊“嗯“了一声，连眼皮都没有眨。
医师的手掌按在伤口上，灵气缓缓注入。

一阵剧烈的疼痛传来，像是有人用烧红的针在骨头里搅动。
顾渊的身体绷紧了，指节发白，但他没有出声。
只是坐着，背脊笔直，像是一根被钉在地上的铁桩。
朱八斗在旁边看着，圆脸上的肉一颤一颤的，像是那针扎在他身上一样。
“你轻点！“他忍不住说。
医师没有理会他。
灵气在伤口中游走，一点一点地将残留的金色剑气逼出。
每一丝剑气离开身体的时候，顾渊都能感觉到一种细微的撕裂感，像是有什么东西从血肉中被抽离。
这个过程持续了一炷香的时间。
当最后一丝剑气被逼出的时候，顾渊的后背已经被汗水浸透。
医师迅速涂上药膏，缠好绷带，然后转向他的大腿。
“大腿的伤更严重。“
医师说：“缝的线崩断了三根，我得重新缝。“
顾渊低头看着自己的大腿。
伤口像是一张咧开的嘴，血肉外翻，触目惊心。
他点了点头。
没有麻药。
七针，每一针穿过皮肉的时候，顾渊都只是微微皱眉。
朱八斗转过身去，不忍再看。
他的拳头握得死紧，指甲嵌进掌心里，留下一排月牙形的血印。

半个时辰后，伤口处理完毕。
顾渊靠在床头，闭上眼睛。
他的呼吸很浅，但很均匀。
content_en:
, Gu Yuan's legs were shaking when he walked back to the medical shed.
It's not a tremor of fear, it's an instinctive reaction after the body reaches its limit.
The bandage on the left shoulder has been soaked with blood, and dark red blood stains spread on the white cloth, like a splashed ink painting.
The wound on his thigh reopened, and warm liquid flowed down his pants with every step he took, leaving a series of dark red footprints on the bluestone.
Zhu Badou supported him, his huge body bent at a strange angle, trying to let Gu Yuan's arm rest on his shoulders.
"Slow down, slow down."
Zhu Badou's voice was very low, with a nervousness rarely seen in ordinary times: "Stairs, pay attention to the steps."
In the medical shed, Chen Mu was already awake.
He was lying on the straw bed, his face still as pale as paper, but his eyes were open, and his eyes followed Gu Yuan's movements.
His ribs were wrapped in a thick bandage, and there was a faint trace of light red under the white cloth.
"Did you win?" Chen Mu asked.
The voice was very soft, as if coming from a far away place.
"Won."
Zhu Badou helped Gu Yuan to another straw bed: "A sword. Golden. A ten-foot-long lightsaber. It split the green blade of that boy Zhao Xuanlong into two pieces."
Chen Mu said "Hmm", slowly closed his eyelids, and fell asleep again.
Gu Yuan sat on the bed, his back straight, like a sword stuck in the ground.
The doctor came over and untied the bandage on his left shoulder. The wound was exposed to the air - an incision extending from the left shoulder to the collarbone. The bone was deeply visible. The edges were burned by the golden sword energy, showing a strange burnt black color.
The doctor frowned: "There is sword energy remaining in this wound. I have to force out the remaining energy before applying medicine. It will be very painful."
Gu Yuan said "Huh" without blinking.
The doctor pressed his palm on the wound and slowly injected spiritual energy.
A sharp pain came, as if someone was stirring the bones with a red-hot needle.
Gu Yuan's body tensed up and his knuckles turned white, but he didn't make a sound.
He just sat with his back straight, like an iron stake nailed to the ground.
Zhu Badou watched from the side, and the flesh on his round face trembled, as if the needle had pierced him.
"Take it easy!" He couldn't help but say.
The doctor ignored him.
The spiritual energy swam in the wound, forcing out the remaining golden sword energy bit by bit.
Every time the sword energy left his body, Gu Yuan could feel a slight tearing sensation, as if something was being pulled away from his flesh and blood.
This process lasted as long as a stick of incense.
When the last trace of sword energy was forced out, Gu Yuan's back was soaked with sweat.
The doctor quickly applied ointment and bandaged it, then turned to his thigh.
"The injury to the thigh is more serious."
The doctor said: "Three of the suture threads broke and I had to re-sew it."
Gu Yuan looked down at his thigh.
The wound looked like a grinning mouth, with blood and flesh turned out, which was shocking.
He nodded.
No anesthesia.
Seven needles, Gu Yuan just frowned slightly when each needle passed through the flesh.
Zhu Badou turned around and couldn't bear to look anymore.
His fists were clenched tightly, and his nails dug into his palms, leaving a row of crescent-shaped blood marks.
Half an hour later, the wound was treated.
Gu Yuan leaned against the head of the bed and closed his eyes.
His breathing was shallow but even.
